3. Determine if the violations need to be included in SDWIS Fed as “at-risk”. Record in step 9.

5. Determine the name of the PWSID as it is listed in SDWIS (it won’t be correct if you copy and paste from inspection form). This is important because the customer needs to know their correct PWSID in order for their sample results to be entered in SDWIS.
